title: SEC1: Missing SHA3-256 test coverage
description: Test vectors for SHA3-256 exist in tests/vectors/sha3.h (3 NIST FIPS 202 vectors) but test_chardev.c never calls them. SHA3-256 is registered and functional but zero userspace chardev test coverage. Without a test, future renames/refactors in wolfssl_sha.c could silently break SHA3-256 without detection.
